rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that makes people feel uneasy or troubled.

example.english: Getting anonymous calls all the time lately is really unsettling.
example.traditional: 呢排成日收到啲匿名電話，真係令人唔安樂。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 seng4 jat6 sau1 dou2 di1 nik1 ming4 din6 waa2 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 m4 on1 lok6

rows.note: Use this for the same general meaning in more formal or written contexts.

example.english: The contents of the accident report are unsettling.
example.traditional: 有關事故嘅報告內容令人不安。
example.jyutping: jau5 gwaan1 si6 gu3 ge3 bou3 gou3 noi6 jung4 ling6 jan4 bat1 on1

rows.note: Choose this when the unsettling thing is especially chilling, disturbing, or frightening.

example.english: That video of animal abuse was truly unsettling.
example.traditional: 睇完嗰段虐待動物嘅片，我真係覺得令人心寒。
example.jyutping: tai2 jyun4 go2 dyun6 joek6 doi6 dung6 mat6 ge3 pin3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 ling6 jan4 sam1 hon4
